default.title: Obtain the Sinner
default.text: Sorry, sorry... Ran into a bit of traffic on my way here! I'm not late, am I? Hi Chief, I'm Murphy!

default.title: Raise to Phase 1
default.text: I feel like... I've gotten a little braver!

default.title: Raise to Phase 3
default.text: If my bad luck can become a source of strength, then I hope... I can use it well!

default.title: Level Start
default.text: Ladybug, horseshoe, red string, red paper talisman... Okay, got all my lucky charms! Things shouldn't go too wrong!

default.title: Victory
default.text: Did we just win?! Could today be my lucky day?!

default.title: Lose Battles
default.text: ...It's me. I slowed everyone down... I know, it's all my fault...

default.title: Ultimate Skill
default.text: Please... don't miss!

default.title: Die in Battles
default.text: Today... must be my most unlucky day...

default.title: Greeting
default.text: Hey, I get to see you today! How nice!

default.title: Conversation 1
default.text: Oh well, everyone gets unlucky every now and then... or all the time, haha. You just get used to it!

default.title: Conversation 2
default.text: I get this lucky charm from that "immortal" Eastian living in Eastside every New Year's! Not sure if it actually works, but at least it gives me some peace of mind!

default.title: Conversation 3
default.text: I'm always forgetting things, so I carry a notebook with me to jot down important stuff! For example... Chief showed me such a beautiful sky today! It was almost too pretty to be true!

default.title: Special Conversation 1
default.text: Just like you said, this is indeed kind of like... a special power!

default.title: Special Conversation 2
default.text: I did my research! Today's a lucky day, and if you go to a theme park with someone important while wearing cute animal accessories and red lucky charms, you'll have good luck all week! Come with me, Chief!

default.title: Special Conversation 3
default.text: "Chief fixed my tri-fold phone that broke into three pieces." "Chief said I'm not a trouble bringer." Hey Chief, looks like there are more and more entries about you in my notebook. It's basically turning into my "good luck journal"!

default.title: Full Compliance
default.text: People say that having bad luck is like earning credit. You accept your fate, wait for karma to give you a break, and eventually your luck will come. I waited for so long, and then I met you! But... you didn't just bring me a stroke of luck. You gave me the courage to not accept things as they are, to fight back... and that's so much better than just having good luck!

default.title: Idle
default.text: Should I try a new method to boost my luck today...?

default.title: Annoyed
default.text: Hehe, the cat's super soft, isn't it? It's one of my favorite lucky charms!

default.title: Special Attention
default.text: Don't keep staring at me like that... With you here, nothing can go wrong, right?

default.title: Dispatch
default.text: I... I hope this mission goes smoothly...

default.title: Dispatch Complete
default.text: Made it back in one piece! Sure, I tripped three times and got lost twice, but at least I didn't mess up the mission... uh, or did I?

default.title: Level Up
default.text: If even I can get stronger, then this world sure is full of hope!

default.title: Pat Head
default.text: I heard that head pats can transfer good luck! Do it again, Chief!
